text:
emma: Quick flag for the weekly KPI deck 1: dashboard sanity check shows overall conversion stable but the campaign breakdown shows a weird spike in 'social_paid' leads with near-zero revenue. Can someone eyeball whether that's attribution leakage or a tagging issue?

rafael: I pulled the cohort view. Social_paid count jumped +350 on Tues but avg ARR per lead is $0. Looks like form-submission without email confirmation. Could be bot traffic or a bad redirect.

maya: On it. Which dashboard widget are you looking at? link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/kpi-weekly/widgets/lead-breakdown

emma: That one. Also compare last 7d vs rolling 28d for context.

metrics-bot: automated snapshot created (snap=5498) for kpi-weekly at 2026-02-12T09:12:10Z.

oliver: Quick hypothesis: our webinar landing page A/B test swapped CTA variant B on Tuesday and it loads an iframe that strips utm_source for some referrers. If utm_source is missing we fallback to 'social_paid' in the ingestion pipeline. Tagging @growth-frontend to confirm.

rafael: Running a sample query now to surface top 100 social_paid leads: ```SELECT id, email, utm_source, created_at, ip_country FROM leads WHERE campaign = 'social_paid' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;```

maya: Shared the CSV of 100 rows in #private-sales-ops. Headline: 82% of those lack utm_source and 73% have empty email_verified flag. IPs concentrated in BR + unknown ranges.

emma: Sounds like tagging + bot traffic. For the KPI deck I want two bullets: 1) We're investigating a tagging regression that inflated social_paid lead counts; 2) We'll provide corrected cohort metrics before Monday's review.

oliver: Action plan: 1) Growth-frontend will rollback CTA iframe change or add utm preserving param by EOD. 2) Analytics will run a replay to backfill campaign where possible using referrer and landing page path. 3) Ops to add rate-limit checks for form endpoints.

metrics-bot: scheduled replay job (job_id=9876) queued. ETA 22m.

rafael: Pre-replay numbers: total leads=4,210 (7d), social_paid=498, revenue attributed to social_paid=$0. After simulated backfill using referrer heuristics: social_paid_adjusted=126, revenue_social_paid=$84,200. I'll attach the diff to the KPI doc.

maya: I'll add a short appendix slide with before/after visuals and a note on residual uncertainty due to unverified emails. Template: "Correction applied: backfill used referrer heuristics; leads with unverified emails flagged as low-confidence; revenue numbers exclude unverified cohort."

emma: Perfect. Can you paste the three-line SQL we used for the backfill so I can include in the appendix?

rafael: ```UPDATE leads SET campaign = coalesce(utm_campaign, substring(referrer from '/campaigns/([^/?]+)')) WHERE campaign = 'social_paid' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(utm_campaign, substring(referrer from '/campaigns/([^/?]+)')) IS NOT NULL;```

oliver: Noted. I'll follow up with growth-frontend on the CTA fix and add a deploy monitor.

emma: Thanks team. We'll ship the KPI deck with the corrected numbers and the appendix note. If anything else surfaces ping here. :white_check_mark:
